title: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this craniofacial application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (cp-ti) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for craniofacial geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish
commonFailures: Galvanic pitting at Ti-316L interface in vivo - eliminated by ceramic Al2O3 coating on mating surfaces

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Craniofacial Mesh suitable for Reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (CP-Ti)?
faq.a: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address craniofacial operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Craniofacial Mesh?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Craniofacial Mesh require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. craniofacial components receive Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Craniofacial Mesh shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Bone mesh / Facial implant craniofacial components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
